summary: The wall matches the prompt (4 x 1 x 4 m, raised blocks, darker cap and plinth) and is within budget (494/1320), but fails the holes limit and three palette assertions.

findings.observation: 23 open boundary loops (limit 10), no visible gap in any view; one per part (body plus 22 raised blocks), consistent with open-backed blocks flush on the face.

Wet Slate fails after correction (17.7 > 12): #999999 -> #9A9996 against #736B66. The atlas grey is lighter and more neutral than the palette, and the lift-only correction can't darken it; the stone renders neutral rather than warm grey.
findings.evidence: assertion 'palette color Wet Slate within tolerance after correction'

findings.observation: Barrow Oak fails before (22.3 > 20) and after (21.5 > 12) correction; median #D3875E over 35% of the texture. The texture is the shared kit atlas, so the share likely includes atlas regions this piece doesn't sample.
findings.evidence: assertions 'palette color Barrow Oak close before correction', '... within tolerance after correction'; sourcing.atlas

escalation_reason: Sourced CC0 kit piece on a shared atlas: nothing to refine or reroll. The colour assertions measure the whole shared atlas and the lift-only correction can't darken the kit's lighter greys; the user decides between measuring colour over UV-covered texels, allowing darkening for sourced kits, recolouring the atlas, or accepting kit colours. Geometry needs no change.
